response.justification: Despite extensive full-stack and cross-platform experience, the candidate lacks demonstrable C++ expertise in industrial automation contexts, with only a brief, non-detailed mention of C++ in a 6-month NI LabWindows role; core requirements like STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, and industrial protocols are absent from the resume, and the candidate’s recent work is dominated by TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang — not aligned with the role’s C++-centric, security-compliant, industrial automation focus.
strengths: Strong full-stack and systems-level experience across diverse platforms
Proven track record in open-source contributions and technical mentoring
Extensive background in event-driven architectures and distributed systems
concerns: Minimal or unverified C++ experience; no evidence of STL, concurrency, or OOP in industrial contexts
No mention of IEC 62443, secure development lifecycle, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)
Recent work is overwhelmingly web-focused (TypeScript/Node.js), not aligned with on-prem/cloud C++ platform development
